remarks: Historic property with modern appointments on a spectacular 18th century gated compound. Sited on 3.5 sprawling acres, this estate is composed of mature sugar maples, perennial gardens and a fountained koi pond. The setting offers a luxurious oasis one mile from Wilton town center, nationally ranked public schools and is centrally located minutes to all major highways. The residence is composed of four bedrooms, each with en-suite custom bathrooms and 11ft ceilings. Each bathroom has individually unique architectural features including a two person ledge stone shower, a hand hammered copper Waterworks bathtub, open showers with floor to ceiling statuario marble and custom built reclaimed wood vanities. Every bedroom is prewired with surround sound, HDMI and Cat 6 with smart light switches all integrated by a home automation system. For movie enthusiasts, there is a prewired 12 speaker Dolby Atmos home theatre system downstairs. The main room is the center piece of the residence, with a 12a x 15a glass entrance and towering 25ft ceilings with beams made from 200 year old hand cut trees. The open kitchen boasts custom oak cabinets, Mountain White Danby marble countertops, Viking appliances and an eat in island. This open floor plan also includes a full dining area that can accommodate a table for 10 as well as a 30ft living room to suit any furniture arrangements. Addl $600/mo incl 2G fiber internet, electricity, landscaping, snow plow. Propane heat is tenant's responsibility.
